prompt: Create an editable offset gauge from three separate POM blocks, each 0.8 m wide (X), 0.5 m deep (Z), and 0.3 m high (Y). Name them Datum, East, and Return. Their base centers must be (18, 0.8, -6), (19.7, 1.4, -6), and (17.4, 2.1, -6) respectively. East is 1.7 m to the right and 0.6 m above Datum; Return is 0.6 m to the left and 1.3 m above Datum. Group the blocks as Offset gauge, keep them independently editable, and assign POM as their material designation. Preserve all existing objects. Build, inspect and finish without asking routine questions.
policy: One normal live creation plus one read-only injected invalid-criterion correction on the same geometry. No fabricated modeling or reviewer answers.
